Its cutting edge is finely honed.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 38 |durability = 30 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Knight's Claymore}} Knight's Claymores are two-handed weapons that were wielded by the most confident [[Knight of Hyrule|Knights of Hyrule]]. They are commonly found in [[Treasure Chest]]s, but they may also be carried by [[Enemy|Enemies]] in the [[Gerudo Desert]] and on the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. When the following [[amiibo]] are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], they have a chance to drop a Treasure Chest containing a Knight's Claymore: * {{SSB}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Ganondorf]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{OoT}}) amiibo Since they are made of metal, Knight's Claymores will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Sheikah Slate]]'s [[Magnesis]] Rune, which is useful due to the fact that they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, Knight's Claymores will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
